title: Running it
summary: tests/run_tests.sh runs in a temporary copy (never writes the source tree), builds the oorexx_process native from source, pre-checks P7 and P9, and runs test_offline, test_security, test_jobs, test_died (fake curl) and, with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, test_live. WRITE_ENV=1 also writes build/env.sh for bin/nsh.sh. The key is read by the Secret Broker from the environment; never on argv, on disk or in a log. Model default claude-haiku-5-5. Dependencies: oorexx_ai_provider_anthropic v0.5, oorexx_ai_access v0.6, alchemy_objects v0.8, oorexx_secret_broker v0.2, oorexx_crypto v0.1, oorexx_logging v0.7, oorexx_process v0.1-dev2, oorexx_foreign_runtime v0.22.6.
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Tests never write the source tree
The key never reaches argv, disk or a log
